bait_content.title: I/O Conflict: Profile Cache Lock
bait_content.body: An unclean shutdown was detected. A file lock on the browser profile cache (Cookies, LocalStorage, IndexedDB) indicates a pending journal. Continuing may lead to data loss or tab-restore failures. Close other instances and run a safe repair to release locks and reconcile metadata. A relaunch may be requested after completion.
